name: hint.confirm
title: Confirm hints
summary: Confirm hints after a person reviewed them, by ID (hintIds), all of one element (ref, target) or all of some codes in the workspace (all with kind and expected, the total of hint.list with that kind): writes the current target version into the relation or inline reference (in the text or in a property marked `markdown`, SR-127; `relation.outdated`) or into the `replaces` item (`variant.core-changed`, SR-045), and nothing else but the current titles of the file's same-repository targets (D-042); an ID no open hint has gives a warning, for example one confirmed already.
whileReadOnlyReason: Writes the current version of the target, which depends on the metamodel (which properties count).

input.description: Give `hintIds`, `ref`, `target`, `all` or several of them; none is `input.invalid`. `ref` and `target` select the open confirmable hints (those with a `hintId`, as hint.list gives them) about `ref` and pointing at `target`, both when both are given; `all` selects those of the whole workspace and goes with neither (#644). `kind` narrows only that selection and needs `ref`, `target` or `all`; `all` needs `kind` and `expected`, so a call names the codes and the number of hints a person reviewed and never confirms every hint by accident. The selected hints and `hintIds` are confirmed together, as one set (SR-027 AK2): each once, `confirmed` names `hintIds` first, then the selected IDs. A selection without an open confirmable hint is a `hint.not-found` warning, left out when the call already gives `hint.not-confirmable` for the since-baseline hints (SR-103 AK5).

hintIds.description: IDs of hints to confirm (`hintId` of hint.list).

ref.description: Confirm the open confirmable hints about this element: the outdated relations and inline references (in the text and in properties marked `markdown`) its file stores, and its `replaces` items onto a changed core requirement. A variant with open `variant.core-changed-since-baseline` or `variant.core-new-since-baseline` hints, without `kind`, gives `hint.not-confirmable` for them, since a new baseline of the variant settles them (SR-103 AK5).

target.description: Confirm the open confirmable hints on relations and inline references that point at this element, for example after it changed.

all.description: Select the open confirmable hints of the whole workspace with one of the codes of `kind`: those hint.list gives with a hintId for that `kind` and no other filter (#644). Needs `kind` and `expected`; not with `ref` or `target`.

kind.description: Only selected hints with one of these codes (with `ref`, `target` or `all`); the confirmable codes are `relation.outdated` and `variant.core-changed`; `variant.core-changed-since-baseline` and `variant.core-new-since-baseline` give `hint.not-confirmable`, since a new baseline of the variant settles them (SR-103 AK5).

expected.description: The number of hints the call confirms, `hintIds` and the selected ones together, counted as hint.list counts them (a relation written twice is two hints with one ID), as the person reviewed them (with `all`: `total` of hint.list with the same `kind` and no other filter). When the call would confirm another number, it is refused and nothing is written (`input.invalid`, details `count`), for example after a pull brought new hints. Required with `all`.
